items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: I had to do a rhythm section thing on that with Tony Hatch and Barry Galbraith was supposed to do it and then he called me and then I did it.

ctx.x: Just about good timing for you, don’t you think?

That’s right, yes. And in the fifties is when they had like a guitar club where Tony Mottola was number one, Bucky was involved on that, Al Caiola and so many of them, Barry Galbraith, and whenever they had recording sessions that’s the way it would go. Tony would be the first one called out and if he couldn’t make it then it would be the next one, I forgot who was second but say Al Caiola or somebody, then Bucky and on down the line. And I got on a few of those, which was great because I was maybe the thirtieth…
